title: Ned Finds a Soft Spot
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters ft, lt, lf.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling arriving at the open door of a wooden garden shed.
A wooden shelf inside the shed cluttered with pots and rags.
Ned the duckling using his bill to nudge small pots into a neat row on the shelf.
Ned the duckling pressing one webbed foot gently on a soft rag.
Ned the duckling nudging a wobbly shelf bracket back into place with his bill.
Ned the duckling folding the soft rag neatly on top of the shelf.
The tidy wooden shelf, pots in a row and a folded rag on top.
Ned the duckling standing back, pleased with the tidy shelf.
Ned the duckling curled up asleep on the soft folded rag.
